review_output: {"summary":"I found no BLOCKER or MAJOR defects in the supplied scope. I reviewed only the supplied text and did not run anything. The ICS generator looks correct for CRLF, UTC, UTF-8 byte folding, TEXT escaping, the same-origin public URL, and the absence of recipient data, access grants, ATTENDEE/ORGANIZER and VALARM. The additive `title` field on the public DTO is compatible, because `WebinarExperienceResource.title` stays optional and the queries and gates are unchanged. The findings below are MINOR or NIT robustness and test-coverage gaps. This is not a release certification, and the browser download and real-WebM checks remain pending as declared.","findings":[{"severity":"MINOR","file":"src/components/webinar-calendar-download.tsx","area":"download(): null-result error handling","issue":"Every createWebinarCalendar null is shown as '活動已開始或資料已變更'. Nulls also come from a title over 160 characters or containing control characters, a slug or path outside [A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,100}, or a bad origin. For those inputs the button never works, and the message wrongly tells the user the event has started or changed.","evidence":"createWebinarCalendar returns null for the time, title, slug, broadcastPath and origin checks alike. The component maps all of them to one start-or-changed message. The title is passed as `resource.live.title ?? videoTitle` with no truncation or normalization.","impact":"An upcoming webinar with a long Live title or a non-conforming step path shows a working-looking button that always fails with a misleading message. The user has no recovery path. The data stays safe.","recommended_fix":"Return a reason code, or split the validation into time-based and data-based checks. Show a distinct 'cannot generate calendar' message for data errors. Optionally truncate the title by code point to the bound, or confirm that upstream Live title and slug validation guarantees these constraints.","required_test":"Component test with a 161-character title, and another with a slug containing '.', each asserting the data-error message is not the 'already started' message. Also assert the started-event case still shows the started message.","confidence":0.6},{"severity":"MINOR","file":"src/components/webinar-calendar-download.tsx","area":"Click handler behavior (no component-level test)","issue":"The tests cover only server-rendered markup and the pure generator. The click path has no automated test. That path covers the preview no-op, recheck of now on click, Blob creation with MIME type, filename, anchor cleanup, revoke timing and the error state.","evidence":"funnel-webinar-experience.test.tsx uses renderToStaticMarkup only. The Playwright download assertion is declared pending.","impact":"A regression in the click recheck, in preview blocking, or in URL.createObjectURL failure handling would not be caught before the browser run.","recommended_fix":"Add a jsdom/RTL test with fake timers. Mock URL.createObjectURL and revokeObjectURL, and spy on anchor click.","required_test":"(1) Click after the start time creates no Blob and shows an alert. (2) preview=true creates no Blob. (3) A successful click sets download='webinar.ics', removes the anchor, and revokes after 30s. (4) createObjectURL throwing shows the error message.","confidence":0.7},{"severity":"MINOR","file":"src/lib/webinar-calendar.ts","area":"Date validation (lines with start/end/utc checks)","issue":"An Invalid Date or a year above 9999 in startsAt or endsAt is not explicitly rejected. The year-below-1 guard does not catch NaN, and `now` is the only date checked against 9999. `toISOString()` throws RangeError on an invalid date and emits extended-year strings (+010000-…) for years above 9999. The string comparison utc(end) <= utc(start) also becomes wrong for such strings.","evidence":"`start.getUTCFullYear() < 1` is false for NaN. `utc(end)` is then called outside any try/catch, and createWebinarCalendar is called from the click handler outside its try block.","impact":"This is reachable only if parseFunnelWebinarSettings admits such values, which is not shown in the supplied text. If it does, the click handler throws an uncaught exception instead of failing closed, or the generator emits an invalid DTSTART.","recommended_fix":"Require Number.isFinite(start.getTime()) and Number.isFinite(end.getTime()), and 1 <= year <= 9999 for start and end. Alternatively compare getTime() values after flooring to seconds.","required_test":"Unit tests with schedule.startsAt='not-a-date' (if the parser permits it) and a +010000 year, each expecting null and no throw.","confidence":0.35},{"severity":"NIT","file":"src/lib/webinar-calendar.ts","area":"VEVENT properties (UID/DTSTAMP, no SEQUENCE)","issue":"The UID is stable across reschedules, but there is no SEQUENCE. Some calendar clients (e.g. Outlook, Apple Calendar) may ignore or duplicate a re-imported event with the same UID and different times.","evidence":"The UID is 'celebratedeal-live-<id>' and the lines contain no SEQUENCE. The UI tells users to update the event manually.","impact":"A manual update on reschedule may produce duplicates or no change, depending on the client. This is a UX compatibility concern and does not affect privacy.","recommended_fix":"Add a monotonic SEQUENCE, for example a number derived from the update timestamp, or document that the user should delete the old event. A domain-qualified UID is optional.","required_test":"Manual import of two .ics files with the same UID and different times into the target calendar clients.","confidence":0.3},{"severity":"NIT","file":"tests/e2e/wp17-quick-webinar.spec.ts","area":"Added WP14 block, viewport loop","issue":"The loop leaves the shared `viewer` page at width 390 for the remaining verification and playback steps.","evidence":"`for (const width of [1280,390]) {await viewer.setViewportSize(...)}` has no restore, and the later email delivery and verification steps reuse `viewer`.","impact":"Later assertions run under a different layout than before, which could cause incidental flakiness or hide desktop-only regressions.","recommended_fix":"Restore the original viewport after the loop, or use a separate page or context for the screenshots.","required_test":"Run the full wp17 spec and confirm the later steps pass at the original viewport.","confidence":0.4}]}
